review_notes: I read the whole file. I searched Mathlib's lpSpace.lean and Mathlib broadly for a DFinsupp-to-lp embedding, such as a linear map from Π₀ i, E i into lp E p. I found none. Mathlib has only lp.lsingle, lp.single, lp.hasSum_single and linearMapOfLE, none of which duplicates `finite`. `dualInclude` is a thin named wrapper around Mathlib's `precomp` and `lp.evalCLM`, so it is a useful named specialisation and not a competing concept. `dualHead` is built from existing Mathlib operations.
